outcome_values_inspected_before_freeze: none; only finite-row counts of model inputs and of the 24h target were read, and no metric, coefficient, prediction, or target distribution statistic was computed
claim: The sealed FCLR-011 funding-conditioned volatility PASS (C2 vs B1, +4.94% relative QLIKE reduction, 5 instruments, 3 blocks, 2026-05..2026-08) does NOT replicate on a disjoint, never-tested 2024-07-23..2024-09-30 rolling-origin walk-forward over the cached Binance public archive. A CONFIRMED verdict requires >=2% relative QLIKE reduction with a 95% day-block bootstrap CI excluding zero on the improving side, >=5 instruments, >=3 non-overlapping test blocks, Holm across the declared family, LOIO >=4/5, funding-permutation placebo PASS, and a leakage audit PASS.

why_this_is_new.problem_with_prior_period_tests: Every volatility period test in this repository is either the sealed FCLR-011 window (2026-05..2026-08), the forward 2026-08..2026-10 confirmation (NOT_REPLICATED), or the 2025-02..2025-05 cross (NOT_REPLICATED, rel 0.29%). No test has used 2024 data at any hour.
why_this_is_new.untested_window: The cached Binance archive holds complete hourly mark/premium/index klines for the five FCLR-011 symbols over 2024-07-01..2024-09-30 and 8-hourly funding from 2024-04. 2024 H2 is a documented high-funding-stress regime (the 2024-08-05 carry unwind and the 2024-09 FOMC cut are both inside the test blocks), which is the strongest available test of regime-specificity.
why_this_is_new.not_a_relitigation: The sealed FCLR-011 artifact is not mutated or re-scored. This is a new period with identical models, metric, contrasts, and gate structure, so the null can be broken on genuinely fresh out-of-sample evidence.
why_this_is_new.no_label_use: No liquidation label is consumed. This arm is volatility-only.

mark.cached_coverage: 2024-07-01..2024-09-30 (verified: mark/premium/index day directories present for all 92 days)

coverage_audit.note: Coverage only: finite-row counts. No outcome statistic computed. Every block has >=5 instruments on both sides and >=1080 training rows.

universe.rule: the five FCLR-011 symbols, restricted to the months with complete cached mark/premium/index klines (2024-07..2024-09)

features.estimator: OLS on log forward-horizon RV with train-only standardization and smearing; identical implementation to scripts/fclr_fwd_vol_confirm.py::fit_predict
features.target: target_Hh = sum of hourly squared log returns over the next H hours; features strictly causal, target strictly forward

splits.design: rolling-origin walk-forward; each block refits on all data up to its train_end; 7-calendar-day embargo between train end and test start
splits.block_rule: Three non-overlapping test blocks, each preceded by a 7-day embargo. Blocks 0 and 1 are full 30 days; block 2 is 15 days because the cached mark-price coverage ends 2024-09-30. No padding, no imputation, and no test rows are dropped for missing inputs.
splits.train_span_note: Training span grows per block (1,080 / 4,440 / 7,680 rows). log_rv168h and ema_dist are therefore available in every training span; abs_fund_pct has >=30 trailing 8-hourly funding observations at every origin because funding history begins 2024-04.
splits.no_inspected_overlap: No hour in this window was used in FCLR-011 (2026-05..2026-08), FCLR-FWD-VOL-011-CONFIRM (2026-08..2026-10), FCLR-FWD-VOL-2025-CROSS (2025-02..2025-05), or any sealed cell.

gates.ci_method: day-block bootstrap over UTC days, pooled across blocks
gates.holm_family: all horizon x contrast x block cells
gates.loio_note: leave one instrument out of training, evaluate on the held-out instrument
gates.placebo_rule: permute signed_funding and abs_fund_pct within symbol; true relative reduction must exceed the null 95th percentile
gates.leakage_rule: every feature strictly causal at t; target strictly forward; 7-day embargo between train end and test start

verdict_rule.CONFIRMED: materiality_ge_2pct AND ci_excludes_zero_improving AND holm_pass AND loio_ge_4_of_5 AND placebo_pass AND leakage_audit_pass AND instruments_ge_5 AND blocks_ge_3
verdict_rule.FRAGILE: materiality_ge_2pct AND ci_excludes_zero_improving but LOIO or placebo FAIL
verdict_rule.NOT_REPLICATED: materiality FAIL or CI includes zero
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: instruments < 5 or blocks < 3 or leakage FAIL or no finite primary rows

forbidden: threshold shopping or feature changes after outcome inspection
reusing an inspected window as a fresh confirmation
declaring a volatility PASS for H1_primary without the confirmatory gate
reusing an execution whose training span was empty (such a run is void, not evidence)
